old_problem: The source never defines WR or its retained/reset hardware state. Adjacent DC/AC rows and DeepSeek's warm-reboot expansion are not authority, and using the wrong reset primitive can entirely miss the intended PCIe recovery boundary.
disposition_reason: ED-06 and the approved warm/cold/AC/DC separation rule prohibit inferring WR from neighboring rows. The missing term is not merely a runtime identifier: it determines whether endpoint power, switch/retimer state, firmware and link training are reset. Until project authority defines WR and the exact control primitive, no command or recovery semantics are reliable. The overnight/720-minute per-cycle evidence plan is preserved, but static review cannot fabricate the core operation.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2210, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2211 / Wistron-BMC-01061-V002 / 3b76e53255823f8f was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Do not equate WR with warm reboot merely because DeepSeek suggests it; obtain the authoritative acronym expansion and precise retained/reset state boundary.
Distinguish WR from row-2208 DC and row-2209 AC cycles and define which CPU, endpoint, switch, retimer, auxiliary-power and firmware states persist.
Require the exact named reboot/reset control path, count/interval/readiness/final state within the overnight/720-minute coverage.
Map every endpoint/slot/serial/BDF through root port/switch/retimer with signed generation/width and health limits.
For every approved cycle record transition, OS Ready, complete enumeration/LnkCap/LnkSta, AER/device, thermal/power and service health; stop on first anomaly.
Preserve logs, drain workloads and protect data; no guessed action, log clear, automatic retry or adjacent-cycle substitution.
No query, reboot/reset, DC/AC action, log clear, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Engineering-defined WR cycle PCIe link recovery matrix
test_case.purpose: Subject the platform to the authoritative project-defined WR state transition and verify every required PCIe endpoint/link returns at approved generation/width after each cycle without boot, error, thermal or service regression.
required_package: Authoritative WR expansion and exact hardware/software state boundary distinct from DC and AC
Approved named reboot/reset control path, cycle count/interval/readiness/final state within 720 minutes
Workload drain, data protection, maintenance authorization and transition audit
AER/retrain/device/thermal/service abort limits and independent console recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending authoritative WR semantics and the exact approved control primitive. Once supplied, preserve baseline topology/logs, drain workloads, execute only the signed WR action for the approved count within the full overnight/720-minute plan, and after every OS Ready checkpoint collect complete mapped `lspci -Dnnvvv`, enumeration, generation/width, transition, AER/device, BMC/host, thermal/power and service evidence. Stop on first anomaly without retry.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved WR transition exercises the signed state boundary, reaches OS Ready by deadline, restores every mapped endpoint/link at required generation/width, produces no prohibited retrain/error/thermal/service anomaly, and finishes in the approved state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while WR semantics or the control primitive is undefined. After approval, wrong transition, boot/readiness timeout, missing endpoint, generation/width downgrade, unexpected retrain/AER/device fault, thermal/power anomaly, unstable service or failed final state is FAIL. A DC/AC cycle, assumed warm reboot or single final snapshot cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until WR state boundary, exact control path, count/timing/final state, topology/link matrix, maintenance approval and recovery are signed.
Drain users/jobs and flush/protect writable data; preserve logs by timestamps.
Authenticate exact SUT/control path and never infer WR from adjacent rows or use an unapproved reboot/reset primitive.
Stop at the first failed cycle; no continuation, automatic retry or autonomous recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and project-approved WR definition distinct from DC/AC
Named control path, cycle schedule, operator authorization and transition audit per cycle
Endpoint/slot/serial/BDF/root-port/switch/retimer map with baseline and every-cycle LnkCap/LnkSta
Every-cycle OS Ready time, complete enumeration and service-health evidence
Correlated AER/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL plus thermal/power evidence with preserved history
First-failure abort/recovery, final-state record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On a transition, boot, link, error, thermal/power or service anomaly, stop the sequence and preserve evidence. The authorized operator uses the independent console and WR-specific signed recovery after the state boundary is known; do not try DC, AC, another reset primitive or automatic retry.
